bookSourceComment: 支持搜索、详情、目录和正文。依据得奇小说网 2026-11-03 的页面结构制作。

ruleContent.content: @js:var m = baseUrl.match(/\/books\/(\d+)\/(\d+)\.html/); var content = ''; if (m) { var aid = m[1]; var cid = m[2]; var chapterUrl = 'https://www.deqixss.com/books/' + aid + '/' + cid + '.html'; var tokenHeaders = JSON.stringify({'Referer': chapterUrl}); var apiHeaders = JSON.stringify({'Referer': chapterUrl, 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest', 'Accept': 'text/plain, */*; q=0.01'}); var scriptUrl = 'https://www.deqixss.com/scripts/chapter.js.php?aid=' + aid + '&cid=' + cid + '&referrer=' + chapterUrl; var script = java.connect(scriptUrl, tokenHeaders).body(); var token = script.match(/chapterToken\s*=\s*'([^']+)'/); var timestamp = script.match(/timestamp\s*=\s*(\d+)/); var nonce = script.match(/nonce\s*=\s*'([^']+)'/); if (token && timestamp && nonce) { var apiUrl = 'https://www.deqixss.com/modules/article/ajax2.php?aid=' + aid + '&cid=' + cid + '&token=' + token[1] + '&timestamp=' + timestamp[1] + '&nonce=' + nonce[1]; var data = JSON.parse(java.connect(apiUrl, apiHeaders).body()); if (data.status === 1 && data.data && data.data.content) { content = data.data.content; } } } content
